empty: Select a clip to view properties

noise.afterUpload: Available once this clip has finished uploading.
noise.appliesGroup_one: Applies to this clip and its group ({{count}} clip).
noise.appliesGroup_other: Applies to this clip and its group ({{count}} clips).
noise.studioTitle: Strong: less noise, no rumble, clearer and more even, softer S sounds

duck.label: Duck
duck.hint: This clip gets quieter while the chosen track plays, and comes back up in the pauses.

modeTitles.person: No green screen needed: finds you in the picture and removes the rest
modeTitles.static: Static background (experimental): removes whatever matches a frame of the empty background

greenScreen.staticHint: Removes everything that looks like a few frames of the empty background. Small changes (noise, light, focus) are ignored and parts of you that match the wall are kept inside your outline. Needs a camera that does not move; shadows you cast stay visible. If parts of the room keep showing, raise Threshold.

hint.green: Removes the green backdrop so the clips on the tracks below show through.
hint.blue: Removes the blue backdrop so the clips on the tracks below show through.
hint.person: No green screen needed: the editor finds the person in every frame and removes the rest. Works best with one person, fully lit, in front of the camera.

greenScreen.plateHint: Move the playhead to a moment that shows only the background, without you in it. Half a second of it is used.
greenScreen.useFrame: Use the frame at the playhead
greenScreen.useFrameInstead: Use the frame at the playhead instead
greenScreen.grabFailed: Could not grab that frame. Try again, or pick another moment.
greenScreen.thresholdStaticTitle: Tolerance: higher ignores more change in the background (noise, light, focus) but can start to remove parts of you
greenScreen.thresholdTitle: Higher removes more of the screen colour
greenScreen.despillStaticTitle: Removes the wall colour from the edges

despillTitle.green: Removes the green tint from the edges
despillTitle.blue: Removes the blue tint from the edges

cameraLock.allLocked: Camera focus and exposure locked, white balance too.
cameraLock.noFocus: Your camera doesn't allow locking focus; avoid moving closer or further.
cameraLock.noExposure: Focus locked. Exposure can't be locked on this camera; keep the light steady.

layout.hint: Drag the clip to move it. Press and hold, then drag, to move the video inside its box. Pinch to zoom on touch screens.

color.autoTitle: Fix levels, midtones and white balance from this clip's frames
color.failed: Could not read this clip's picture.

effects.hide: Hide this effect (kept, but not applied)

multi.cleanGroup: Voice clean-up for all selected clips
multi.afterUpload: Available once these clips have finished uploading.
multi.failed: Cleaning up the voice failed. Try again.
multi.appliesWithGroups_one: Applies to the {{selected}} selected clips and the {{count}} other clip in their groups.
multi.appliesWithGroups_other: Applies to the {{selected}} selected clips and the {{count}} other clips in their groups.
multi.stillUploading: Clips still uploading are left as they are.

reframe.readFailed: The video could not be read here
reframe.openFailed: The video could not be opened for face tracking

personKey.ready: Ready: you are cut out in every frame. The render looks like the preview.
personKey.failed: Could not find a person in this clip ({{error}}).
personKey.finding: Finding you in every frame... The preview already shows it live meanwhile.
personKey.findingProgress: Finding you in every frame: {{percent}} The preview already shows it live meanwhile.

backgrounds.noneTitle: The clips on the tracks below show behind you

personKey.pickStock: Put a stock picture or video behind
personKey.thresholdTitle: Higher keeps less around you, lower keeps more
